key_insight: Molecular Prior Networks predict query-molecule affinity from labelled support molecules in a single transformer pass, without task-specific training.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support early drug discovery when affinity measurements are scarce, but clinical utility is not established.
method: Train a transformer across thousands of existing affinity datasets.
Predict query affinities using labelled support molecules as context.
Compare against kernel regression in a meta-learned molecular feature space.
evidence_signal: On the regression variant of FS-Mol, the model matches state-of-the-art performance for the smallest support sets while being faster than existing methods.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective performance on new drug-discovery projects.
